title: Adaptive traffic splitting for pinned model updates
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Goal: Ship an adaptive canary/A-B traffic-splitting flow that lives behind model pins so product teams can roll new model versions with automated promotion, guarded rollbacks, and fine-grained cohort analysis. Unlike simple fixed-percentage canaries, this feature will: 1) tie promotion decisions to a configurable set of metrics (latency P50/P95, error rate, semantic similarity drift on eval prompts), 2) support per-pin warmup windows and step schedules, and 3) allow deterministic A/B cohorts for retention and downstream metric correlation. The experience should be accessible in the Console under Model -> Versions -> 'Rollout' and via API/SDK for automation and infra use cases.
updates: 2025-03-10: Initial scoping with ENG and Design. Agreed on core primitives: traffic-split rule, metric gates, warmup period, rollback thresholds.

2025-03-12: Design sprint completed; DES provided mockups for Rollout UI with a compact 'promotion policy' editor. See design doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ModelOnboard/Adaptive+Rollouts

2025-03-13: Engineering surfaced two major constraints: runtime needs per-variant routing tokens to be stamped at ingress, and existing metrics pipeline must emit per-pin aggregated P95 within 30s windows (ENG-2847).

2025-03-14: Decided to implement a shadowing mode for the first 48h of any rollout to collect quality signals without affecting production traffic. Shadowed requests will be sampled and scored asynchronously.

2025-03-16: UX review feedback — add an 'auto-promote' toggle with a safety buffer (minimum 5% traffic and 10k tokens/day) and require a human confirmation field for promotions that cross 50% traffic.

2025-03-18: PM signoff on acceptance criteria; engineering to start spike for metrics gating logic and infra routing changes. PR checklist draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/112
acceptance_criteria: Console: 'Rollout' tab available on model version with UI to create a policy behind a pin.
API: POST /rollouts supports policy JSON with metric gates, warmup, step schedule, and auto-promote flag.
Metrics: Per-pin P50/P95 and 'similarity drift' are available in rollout dashboard within 5 minutes of traffic changes.
Safety: Automatic rollback triggers on latency P95 increase > 2x baseline or error rate +1.5 percentage points (configurable) should execute within 1 minute.
Experimentation: Support deterministic user-level A/B cohort assignment and export of cohort IDs for downstream analytics.
Docs: Quickstart + migration guide for pinned variants published in docs site and linked in Console.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: full automation vs. operator control. We will ship with conservative defaults (longer warmup, smaller step increments) and surface advanced options for enterprise customers. Plan to iterate after first 3 pilots (internal infra, one startup, one enterprise). Also need to verify billing edge cases when traffic is split across variants behind the same pin.
